title: seqeralabs/nf-proteindesign - Design mode samplesheet schema
description: Schema for validating samplesheets in design mode using Proteina-Complexa

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample ID must be alphanumeric with underscores or hyphens only

target_pdb.errorMessage: Target PDB must be a valid file path ending in .pdb or .cif

pipeline_config.errorMessage: Pipeline config must be a valid file path ending in .yaml or .yml

target_sequence.errorMessage: Target sequence must be a valid FASTA file path

target_msa.errorMessage: Target MSA must be a valid file path to a pre-computed MSA file (e.g., 'target.a3m')

target_template.errorMessage: Target template must be a valid file path to a PDB or CIF file
